none: PAS CAM-A7F3F2: Roman Coin : A base silver radiate of Salonina, sole reign, AD260-268
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A base silver radiate of Salonina, sole reign, AD260-268 (Reece period 13). Mint is Rome. Reverse legend reads VESTA. Reverse shows Vesta standing left, holding transverse sceptre and patera. See Cunetio p.112, no.996. Obverse shows draped bust right, on crescent. Obverse legend reads SALONINA AVG. Condition is fine. Die axis is 12 o'clock, weight is 2.61g, diameter is 20.49mm
